name: FarmKonnect Precision Farming Data Centre, Ibadan
notes: Public reports describe FarmKonnect inaugurating a precision-farming data centre in Ibadan. This appears to be an agri-tech/data operations centre rather than a carrier-neutral colocation or hyperscale data-center facility; no MW disclosed.

name: Plateau State-Karios Technologies USA Data Centre Development MOU
developer: Plateau State Government / Karios Technologies USA
notes: Plateau State Government social-media notice says the state and Karios Technologies USA signed an MOU covering innovation in data-centre development. Treated as an announced early-stage project; no site, capacity, schedule, or independent corroboration found in targeted searches for Jos/Plateau data center terms.

name: Equinix/MainOne PR1 Data Center, Port Harcourt
notes: Equinix announced PR1 as a new carrier-neutral facility in Port Harcourt opening in Q1 2025, with about 500kW capacity and proximity to the 2Africa cable landing. Later trade coverage indicates the facility was completed/opened, so status is operational.

name: interconnectnigeria Port Harcourt Data Centre
notes: Data Center Map lists an interconnectnigeria data centre in Port Harcourt and links to the operator. Operator pages reviewed publicly identify the company but do not disclose MW, tier, or detailed facility specifications.

name: Sokoto State Data Centre Project
notes: PM News reports Sokoto State's 2026 budget includes a state data centre and ICT/computer training centres as part of digital-economy and e-government infrastructure. No site, capacity, tier, procurement award, or construction evidence found.

Targeted searches for Taraba, Jalingo, Wukari, data center/datacentre/data centre/server farm/hyperscale/colocation/cloud-region terms and major operator names found no public evidence of a physical data-center project or facility in Taraba State.

name: Yobe State ICT Hub / Government Data Centre
developer: Yobe State Government / Yobe State Information Technology Development Agency
notes: Yobe State IT agency social-media material references provision of a data centre at/with the Yobe State ICT Hub. Treated as an announced public-sector ICT facility; no independent confirmation, exact site, MW, or construction status found in targeted searches for Damaturu/Yobe.

name: Zamfara State Electronic Certificate / Mini Data Centre
notes: Zamfara State Government says it launched an Electronic Certificate System and commissioned a mini data centre at Government House, Gusau. Government ICT/data-sovereignty facility; no MW or tier disclosed.
